library_empty_body: Add a folder of comics, manga or books. Omnileaf reads it where it is.
library_series_failed: Couldn't load your library. Try again later.
library_unchanged: Nothing in your library has changed.
general_opens_last_book_hint: The reader, where you left it; the library when there's none.
library_category_tabs_hint: Your categories as tabs above the library.
library_covers_fit_width: Fits as many as the width allows (now {count})
library_continue_row_hint: Books you've started, above the library
library_filter_adult_hint: Adult age rating, or marked by hand.
library_smart_filters_hint: They combine with the filters above.
library_smart_quick_reads_hint: Under 30 minutes left, at your reading speed.
library_smart_duplicates_hint: The same book in more than one folder, even renamed.
library_smart_clean_up_waits: Ready to clean up (downloaded and finished) appears once you have downloads.
library_sort_a_to_z_change: Order: A to Z. Change to Z to A
library_sort_z_to_a_change: Order: Z to A. Change to A to Z
library_sort_newest_first_change: Order: newest first. Change to oldest first
library_sort_oldest_first_change: Order: oldest first. Change to newest first
library_no_matches_one: {filter} leaves nothing. Your library hasn't changed.
library_no_matches_many: {filters} together leave nothing. Your library hasn't changed.

match.countPlural=one: For 1 series. Done applies the changes to it.
match.countPlural=other: For {formattedCount} series. Done applies the changes to all {formattedCount}.

adult_content_intro: A series counts as 18+ when its details carry an adult age rating, or when you mark it 18+ in Edit details.
adult_content_hide_help: Left out of the library, its counts and search.
adult_content_age_ratings: Use age ratings from book details
adult_content_age_ratings_help: Off: only series you mark 18+ by hand count.

match.countPlural=one: {formattedCount} book is a CBR file, which this version can't open yet.
match.countPlural=other: {formattedCount} books are CBR files, which this version can't open yet.

library_folder_unreadable_body: Omnileaf may not be allowed to open it, or it may have moved. Your library hasn't changed.
library_folder_picker_unavailable_title: Adding folders isn't available on this device yet
library_folder_picker_unavailable_body: It's coming in a later version of Omnileaf.
library_folder_chooser_missing_body: Omnileaf opens folders through xdg-desktop-portal. Install it and the portal for your desktop, such as xdg-desktop-portal-gnome, xdg-desktop-portal-kde or xdg-desktop-portal-gtk. Your library hasn't changed.
library_add_folder_failed_body: Something went wrong inside Omnileaf. Your library hasn't changed.
browse_empty_body: Sources you add show up here, so you can read from them without copying files over.
browse_empty_later: Adding sources comes in a later version.
history_empty_body: Books you open show up here, newest first, so you can pick up where you left off.
history_failed: Couldn't load your history. Try again later.
about_licence: Omnileaf is free software. You can share and change it under the GNU General Public License, version 3.
about_copy_failed: Couldn't copy the version details. Try again.
about_report_problem_hint: Opens GitHub. You'll need a GitHub account.
about_browser_unavailable: Couldn't open your browser. Try again.
about_licences_hint: The packages Omnileaf is built with

match.countPlural=one: Omnileaf is built with {formattedCount} open-source package. Open it to read its licence.
match.countPlural=other: Omnileaf is built with {formattedCount} open-source packages, grouped by licence. Open one to read its licence.

library_settings_folders_hint: Folders of comics, manga or books. Omnileaf reads them where they are.
library_settings_home_folder_hint: Your library, reading progress and backups are kept here.
library_folders_failed: Couldn't load your folders. Try again later.
library_remove_folder_note: Its books leave your library. The files stay where they are, and you can add the folder again.
library_rescan_unreachable: {name} isn't available. Its books stay in your library until it's back.
library_found_empty_body: Its books stay in your library in case its drive isn't connected. If you emptied it, remove them.
library_remove_books_note: The folder stays linked, and its files are never touched. Reading progress is kept and comes back if the books do.
library_remove_books_failed_body: Nothing in your library has changed. Try again, or rescan {name} first.
reading_skip_up_next_help: Go straight to the next chapter or volume. Handy for webtoons.
reading_swipes_help: In a series' list on a phone. Mark read marks a book that's read unread.
appearance_system_hint: System follows the device's setting and changes with it.
first_launch_welcome_body_phone: Comics, manga, webtoons and books in one reader. Your library stays on your phone.
first_launch_welcome_body_tablet: Comics, manga, webtoons and books in one reader. Your library stays on this device.
first_launch_welcome_body_desktop: Your library stays on this computer. No account needed.
first_launch_promise_folders_detail_phon: Link your folders. Nothing is copied or moved.
first_launch_promise_folders_detail_desk: Link folders, drives and network shares. Nothing is copied or moved.
first_launch_promise_reading: Reads each series the right way
first_launch_promise_reading_detail_phon: Pages, right to left or a long strip, chosen for you.
first_launch_promise_reading_detail_desk: Two pages, right to left or a long strip, chosen for you.
first_launch_promise_private_detail_phon: Your books and history stay on this phone unless you sync.
first_launch_promise_private_detail_tabl: Your books and history stay on this device unless you sync.
first_launch_promise_private_detail_desk: No account. Your books and history stay here unless you sync.
first_launch_home_body: Omnileaf keeps your progress, categories and backups in this folder. Books you download or import go here too. The comics you already have stay where they are.
first_launch_home_title_ios: Your backups and books are in Files
first_launch_home_body_ios: Omnileaf keeps your backups, and books you add, in its own folder in the Files app, so they're easy to copy or move. Your progress and categories stay safely inside the app.
first_launch_ready_body: Your library is ready. Add or remove folders any time in Settings › Library.
first_launch_finish_failed: Couldn't finish setting up. Try again.
first_launch_tagline: Comics, manga, webtoons and books in one reader.
first_launch_choices_body: Change any of these later in Settings.
first_launch_choices_appearance_help_pho: Paper light or dark, or follow your phone.
first_launch_choices_appearance_help_tab: Paper light or dark, or follow this device.
first_launch_link_body: Link the folders they're in. Omnileaf reads them where they are and never moves or changes them.
first_launch_link_hint_android_phone: Folders on your phone, an SD card or a USB drive all work.
first_launch_link_hint_android_tablet: Folders on this device, an SD card or a USB drive all work.
first_launch_link_hint_ios: Folders in Files, iCloud Drive or a connected drive all work.
first_launch_link_hint_desktop: Folders on this computer, external drives and network shares all work.
language_phone_hint: Omnileaf uses your phone's language unless you pick one.
language_more_coming: More languages arrive as people translate Omnileaf.
screenshot_mode_off_status: Swap names and covers for stand-ins before you share a screenshot or a report.
screenshot_mode_on_status: On until you turn it off
screenshot_mode_what_changes: Titles, writers, covers, chapter titles, summaries, tags, and the names of folders, servers and your own categories, shelves and profiles become stand-ins. 18+ is hidden and not counted. Counts, dates, progress and settings otherwise stay real, so a bug still shows.
screenshot_mode_blank_pages: Blank the pages in the reader
screenshot_mode_blank_pages_help: Plain grey panels with the page number. Turn off to show a page display problem.
screenshot_mode_show_label_help: At the top of the screen, so you know it’s on.
screenshot_mode_show_label_help_desktop: At the top of the window, so you know it’s on.
screenshot_mode_auto_off_help: In case you forget it’s on.
screenshot_mode_nothing_sent: Nothing about Screenshot mode is sent anywhere. It only changes what’s on screen and in reports.
stand_in_summary: What {series} is about stays hidden while Screenshot mode is on.
screenshot_mode_preview_label: Preview of one cover with Screenshot mode off and on
problem_page_missing_body: The link may be out of date. Nothing in your library has changed.
problem_page_failed_body: Something went wrong inside Omnileaf. Nothing in your library has changed.
problem_library_newer_title: This library is from a newer Omnileaf
problem_library_newer_body: A newer version of Omnileaf last opened your library, so this one can't read it. Update Omnileaf to open your library again. Nothing in it has changed.
problem_library_failed_body: Something went wrong inside Omnileaf while opening your library. Nothing in it has changed. Quit and open Omnileaf again, and report the problem if it keeps happening.
privacy_crash_reports_hint: You see a report before it's sent.
crash_report_body: Nothing was lost. If you report it, only the details below are sent, never your library or files.
crash_report_body_last_time: Omnileaf closed unexpectedly last time. Nothing was lost. If you report it, only the details below are sent, never your library or files.
crash_report_always: Always send reports like this, without asking
crash_report_copy_failed: Couldn't copy the details. Try again.
crash_report_browser_unavailable: Couldn't open your browser. Try again.
crash_report_not_sent: Couldn't send the report. Try again.
animations_intro: All four are on until you turn them off. Each switch works at once; with one off, those things appear and go without moving.
animations_navigation_help: Screens slide in and out, and the tab bar's highlight moves.
animations_navigation_help_desktop: Pages change with a short fade, and the sidebar's highlight moves.
animations_sheets_help: Sheets, menus, dialogs and toasts slide or grow into place.
animations_reader_help: The reader's bars and its sheets slide and fade.
animations_reader_help_desktop: The reader's bars, Reading settings and Jump to a book slide and fade.
animations_loading_help: Placeholders pulse and progress bars fill smoothly. Spinners always turn, at half speed with this off.
animations_reduce_motion: Reduce motion in your phone's settings already turns slides and springs into fades or nothing everywhere, whatever you choose here.
animations_reduce_motion_desktop: Reduce motion in your computer's settings already turns slides and springs into fades or nothing everywhere, whatever you choose here.
animations_page_turns: Page turns are set in Reading settings.
advanced_note_body: These tools are only in development builds and never ship.
advanced_scheduled_rescans: Check folders for new books while Omnileaf is open
advanced_scheduled_rescans_help: New books show up without a rescan. Turn off to save battery.
crash_test_panic_body: Panics on a background thread, then offers the report the way the next launch would.
crash_test_interface_body: Throws an error the interface doesn't handle; its report is offered straight away.
crash_test_quit_body: Panics and quits. Open Omnileaf again to see the report it kept.
crash_test_quit_note: It quits straight away. Open it again to see the crash report it kept.
search_filter_example: For example, “{unread} harbour” finds unread series with harbour in the title.
search_nothing_hint: Check the spelling, or search for part of a title.
search_failed: Couldn't search your library. Try again.
quick_open_field: Search or go to a page
series_failed: Couldn't load this series. Try again later.
series_not_found: This series isn't in your library
series_not_found_body: Its books may have been removed, or the folder holding them taken out of the library.
series_all_read: You’ve read every book in this series
series_all_read_body: New books in its folder show up here.
series_books_failed: Couldn't load the books in this series. Try again later.
series_no_unread: Every book in this series is read.
series_no_bookmarked: No book in this series has a bookmark.
creator_empty: No series by {name} in your library
creator_empty_body: Their files may have moved or been removed. Nothing else in your library has changed.
series_no_books_body: Its folder is empty, or its books have moved. Rescan to look again. Nothing else in your library has changed.
series_no_match: No book in this series matches “{search}”.
series_mark_failed: Couldn't mark those books. Try again.
reader_full_screen_leave: Press F or Esc to leave.
reader_guide_tap_body: Tap the right edge for the next page and the left edge to go back. Tap the middle to show the controls.
reader_guide_tap_body_rtl: Tap the left edge for the next page and the right edge to go back. Tap the middle to show the controls.
reader_guide_click_body: Click the right third for the next page and the left third to go back. Click the middle to show the controls. → and Space work too.
reader_guide_click_body_rtl: Click the left third for the next page and the right third to go back. Click the middle to show the controls. ← and Space work too.
reader_jump_or_close: Jump to a book, or close it
reader_shortcuts_typing: While you type in a field, letter keys such as G type; Esc there clears the text first, then closes the panel.
reader_shortcuts_escape: Esc closes an open panel first, then leaves full screen, then goes back. The mouse's back button goes back too.
reader_shortcuts_reversed: In right to left, ← turns to the next page and → goes back.
reader_applies_to_all: Changes here apply to every series.
reader_fit_zoom_hint: Pinch or double-tap a page to zoom.
reader_skip_this_screen_help: Go straight on next time. Also in Settings › Reader.
reader_turn_again: Turn the page again to start {title}
reader_press_again: Press {key} or Space again to start {title}, Esc to go back to the series.
reader_press_again_to_series: Press {key} or Esc to go back to the series.
reader_turn_again_to_series: Turn the page again to go back to the series
reader_series_finished: You've read every book in this series
reader_series_finished_body: When a new book lands in its folder, it shows up here.
reader_direction_found: Found in its details. Remembered for {series}.
reader_damaged_count: {readable} of its {promised} pages can be read.
reader_damaged_ends_early_body: The file may not have finished copying. Copy it again to get every page. Nothing else in your library has changed.
reader_page_failed_body: Page {page} may be damaged. The rest of {title} still opens.
reader_not_found: This book isn't in your library
reader_not_found_body: It may have been removed, or the folder holding it taken out of the library.
reader_unreadable_body: Its file may have moved, or be damaged.
reader_failed: Couldn't open this book. Try again later.
